tools.name: rivo_get_shop
tools.description: Return the store's details (name, domain, currency and loyalty settings). Merchant API: GET /v1/shop.

tools.name: rivo_list_customers
tools.description: List the store's customers with their loyalty status, VIP tier and points balance. Filter by status or points range. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: rivo_get_customer
tools.description: Return one customer by Shopify customer ID or e-mail: loyalty status, VIP tier and points. Optional extra fields: next_vip_tier, lifetime_earnings_tally, completed_earning_rule_ids, points_breakdown. Merchant API: GET /v1/customers/{customer_identifier}.

tools.name: rivo_list_points_events
tools.description: List points events (points earned or spent, adjustments, expiries). Filter by customer and applied date. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_events.

tools.name: rivo_list_points_redemptions
tools.description: List points redemptions (a customer spends points on a reward and gets a discount code). Filter by customer, reward or discount code. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_redemptions.

tools.name: rivo_get_points_redemption
tools.description: Return one points redemption by id: customer, reward, points spent and discount code. Merchant API: GET /v1/points_redemptions/{id}.

tools.name: rivo_list_rewards
tools.description: List the store's loyalty rewards (points cost, value, enabled state, redemption count). Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/rewards.

tools.name: rivo_get_reward
tools.description: Return one loyalty reward by id. Merchant API: GET /v1/rewards/{id}.

tools.name: rivo_list_vip_tiers
tools.description: List the store's VIP tiers (name, threshold and perks). Merchant API: GET /v1/vip_tiers.

tools.name: rivo_list_referrals
tools.description: List referrals (a referrer invites a friend; the referral completes or is blocked). Filter by status, customers or date. Returns data and links.next_since_id. Merchant API: GET /v1/referrals.

tools.name: rivo_list_favorite_products
tools.description: List the products one customer saved as favourites. Merchant API: GET /v1/favorite_products (customer_id is a required query parameter).

tools.name: rivo_adjust_customer_points
tools.description: WRITE: add or subtract points (and store credits) for one customer, as a manual points event. Positive numbers add, negative numbers subtract. The internal note is for the merchant; the external note is shown to the customer. Merchant API: POST /v1/points_events.

tools.name: rivo_set_reward_enabled
tools.description: WRITE: turn one loyalty reward on or off for customers. Other reward settings stay as they are. Merchant API: PUT /v1/rewards/{id}.

tools.name: rivo_add_favorite_product
tools.description: WRITE: save a product (optionally a variant) to one customer's favourites. Merchant API: POST /v1/favorite_products.

tools.name: rivo_remove_favorite_product
tools.description: WRITE: remove a product from one customer's favourites. Merchant API: DELETE /v1/favorite_products/{product_id}.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "rivo_list_points_redemptions" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: customer, reward_id, code, used, applied_from, applied_before, sort_direction, since_id, limit
